guideNote: Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide. Facts are cited to the numbered sources; where sources disagree, both versions are shown. Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones.
list: Official 55-trophy list as published on PlayStation (mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; 0 online

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Every trophy is offline single-player, so one playthrough is enough [1][3]. It is the last trophy by definition, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap, not a task of its own [5].
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then strangers and cleanup [1][3].
Keep the single possibly missable trophy safe: do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude) [1].
Track the 54 others here; the platinum unlocks automatically when the last one lands [5].
No online play, no DLC and no difficulty setting are involved [1][3].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as you play and cannot be missed [1][3].
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Start the story and play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, as Jason and Lucia [1].
Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission; the trophy pops on completion [3].
No extra condition applies — finishing the mission is the whole requirement [5].
If you are chasing the missable meditation, do it right after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth (see Positive Mental Attitude) [1].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It pops when the chapter's last mission ends, and it cannot be missed [1][3]. Do the balcony meditation before this chapter closes — see Positive Mental Attitude [1].
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Play every Chapter 1 story mission in order until the chapter closes [1].
Before the final Chapter 1 mission, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (after Down to Earth) [1][3].
Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter: there is no mission replay [1].
The trophy unlocks automatically when Chapter 1 completes [5].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed [1][3]. From this chapter on, both protagonists become playable together, which the last meditation spot needs [1].
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play through Chapter 2's story missions in order [1].
Pick up optional missions as they appear (purple icons, and black icons with pink letters) [3].
Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars as you travel — both count toward 100% later [1].
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 ends [5].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Automatic on chapter completion, impossible to miss [1][3]. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals on the way — the 100% checklist only needs 200 of 277 vehicle models and 100 of 255 animals [1].
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play through Chapter 3's story missions in order [1].
Keep WAiNK-scanning every unfamiliar vehicle; a scan alone counts as discovering it [8].
Study animals through binoculars when you pass them; hunting is not required for the count [1].
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 ends [5].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Automatic on chapter completion, impossible to miss [1][3]. The story has five chapters in total, so one more chapter follows this one [1].
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play through Chapter 4's story missions in order [1].
Use spare time between missions on side activities you have not tried yet (see Master of None) [3].
Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter — missions cannot be replayed [1].
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 ends [5].

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission of Chapter 5. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed [1][3]. After the ending you return to free-roam, and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats [1][3].
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Finish Chapter 5 and play the final mission to its end [1].
Do not use cheats on your platinum save: they disable trophies and saving [1].
After the credits, free-roam stays open, so nothing story-related is missable [1].
Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the stage-2 checklist [3].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Breakfast Run. It pops on mission completion and cannot be missed [1][3].
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story and play it through [1].
Follow the mission objectives to the end; no side condition is attached [3].
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes [5].
If a mission ever feels failed, retry it from the pause menu — there is no mission replay after the fact [1].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops on mission completion and cannot be missed [1][3].
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in the story and play it through [1].
Complete every objective the mission sets; the trophy is tied to finishing it, not to a rating [3].
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes [5].
Heist practice here pays off later: bank vaults and bank jobs return in the 100% checklist [3].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play. It pops on mission completion and cannot be missed [1][3].
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Reach the mission Child's Play in the story and play it through [1].
Follow the mission objectives to the end [3].
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes [5].
Keep a manual save before big story missions — there is no mission replay [1].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Headliners. It pops on mission completion and cannot be missed [1][3].
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Reach the mission Headliners in the story and play it through [1].
Complete the mission's objectives to the end [3].
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes [5].
Story trophies like this one need no extra setup — just finish the mission [1].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission VCIA Takedown. It pops on mission completion and cannot be missed [1][3]. Note the airport: the separate trophy Catch Me If You Can is about leaving VCIA in an unscheduled way, so do not confuse the two [2][5].
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in the story and play it through [1].
Complete the mission's objectives to the end [3].
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes [5].
Catch Me If You Can is a different, non-story trophy at the same airport — handle it separately in stage 2 [2].

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops on mission completion and cannot be missed [1][3].
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in the story and play it through [1].
Complete the mission's objectives to the end [3].
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes [5].
Combat practice here helps later with Gunslinger and the shooting ranges [1].

dispute.a: PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at about 200 hours, with this checklist taking roughly 100 of them [1].
dispute.b: Push Square puts the platinum at 300 hours or more [8]. Both agree this trophy is the longest grind either way.

trophies.guide: Gold for reaching 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, after the story [1][3]. Both PowerPyx and KeenGamer call it the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx says it is closer to 60% true completion [1]. Only some tasks need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests [1].
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist only becomes visible afterwards, but earlier progress already counts [1].
Clear every robbery the checklist asks for: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vault robberies [3].
Finish the collectible lines: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 flamingos [3][8].
Win the races, earn all 42 shooting-range gold medals and finish the drone races [3].
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the 10 hardest [1].
Scan 200 of 277 vehicle models and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars [1].
Check Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after each session and clear the shortest lines first [1][3].

dispute.a: The trophy needs any 250 stunts; PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the game [1].
dispute.b: The 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, so guides that quote 300 are describing 100%, not this trophy [1]. Do 250 for the trophy, 300 for A Long Road.

trophies.guide: Silver for completing 250 stunts — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps, any 250 of the 397 in the game [1][3]. Stunts are tracked in the Progress menu, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you want A Long Road [1].
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Open the stunt list in the Progress menu and pick stunts near where you already travel [1].
Mix the types — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count [3].
Use fast vehicles and, for flights, a plane; repeat a stunt type only where the game counts it again [1].
Stop at 250 for this trophy, but keep a note: 100% completion asks for 300 [1].
Log your count here; the tracker widget counts up to 250 [3].

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Bronze for trying each of the nine activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt [1][3]. One try each is enough — no win or score is required.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Try fishing once — it also opens the route to Baited My Tackle [1].
Try hunting, golf, pool and basketball once each [1].
Enter a shooting-range challenge and a race once each [3].
Play one arcade video game and complete one stunt [1].
Tick each type off here; the ninth try pops the trophy [3].

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges. Push Square names the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero [8]. The ranges are also a 100% checklist line, so these medals do double duty [1].
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Visit Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero [8].
Work through the 42 challenges one range at a time [1].
Learn each challenge's gold threshold first — a silver run tells you how far off you are [3].
Use the weapon the challenge hands you; bringing your own loadout does not help [1].
Gold medals also count toward 100% completion, so finish all 42 before moving on [1][3].

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Bronze for winning a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. KeenGamer counts 42 drone races across those locations, and the drone races are a 100% checklist line too [3]. One win per location is what the trophy asks for.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Find the Top Fun drone-race spots — 14 locations, 42 races between them [3].
Win one race at each location; the trophy tracks locations, not total races [1].
Learn the course with a slow first run, then race it for the win [3].
Drone races also count toward 100%, so finishing all 42 helps A Long Road [1].
Tick locations off here as you win them [3].

trophies.guide: Bronze for winning 20 different races. Different race events count — winning the same race twice does not add a second one [1][3]. Races are also one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Enter races across Leonida — road, off-road and any other race type the game offers [1].
Win each race once; a repeat win on the same event adds nothing [3].
Pick a fast, stable vehicle for the course type and learn the corners first [1].
Count distinct wins here; the trophy pops at 20 [3].

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Bronze for beating Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so try it early for Master of None, then come back for Cal when you know the mechanics [1][3].
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Try fishing once to learn the casting and reeling controls [1].
Find Cal's fishing challenge and accept it [3].
Fish the challenge through and outscore Cal — bait choice and reeling pace decide it [1].
If you lose, retry the challenge; it stays available [3].

trophies.guide: Bronze for completing one arcade game — finishing it, not just starting it. An arcade game is also one of the nine activity types for Master of None [1][3].
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Find an arcade machine in Leonida and start a game [1].
Play it to its end — quitting early does not count [3].
Pick the shortest arcade game you can find if you only want the trophy [1].
This also ticks the video-game activity type for Master of None [3].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Andy's last mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia [1]. Stranger strands sit outside the 100% checklist, so they are stage-3 cleanup [1][3]. Note the risk flag: TechWiser reports some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress [4].
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Play Andy's strand as Lucia — the chain is Lucia-only [1].
Follow Andy's missions in order until his final mission appears [3].
Do not leave stranger chains sitting for whole chapters: TechWiser reports windows tied to story progress [4].
Complete Andy's final mission to pop the trophy [1].
Stranger strands do not count toward 100%, so finish them in stage 3 [3].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Kenton's last mission. Kenton's strand is one of the stranger chains that sit outside the 100% checklist [1][3]. TechWiser reports some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not park this one for the whole game [4].
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Find Kenton's strand and start his missions when they appear [1].
Play the chain through in order until the final mission unlocks [3].
Keep the chain moving as the story advances — windows are reported to follow story progress [4].
Complete Kenton's final mission to pop the trophy [1].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Billy's last mission. Billy's strand is one of the stranger chains outside the 100% checklist [1][3]. TechWiser reports some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress [4].
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Find Billy's strand and start his missions when they appear [1].
Play the chain through in order until the final mission unlocks [3].
Keep the chain moving as the story advances — windows are reported to follow story progress [4].
Complete Billy's final mission to pop the trophy [1].

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

dispute.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer say only Positive Mental Attitude is possibly missable, and every stranger chain can be finished after the story [1][3].
dispute.b: TechWiser, reported by eGamers, says the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows linked to story progress [4]. Play the chains as they appear to be safe on both readings.

trophies.guide: Silver for completing 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The five named stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are part of the eight, so finishing those five leaves three more strands to find [1][3]. Stranger strands do not count toward 100% completion [1].
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Finish the five named stranger finals first: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone [1].
Find three more stranger strands across Leonida — look for the stranger icons on the map [3].
Start each strand when it appears; TechWiser reports windows tied to story progress [4].
Complete all eight strands; the trophy pops on the eighth [1].
These strands sit outside 100%, so they are pure stage-2/3 cleanup [3].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Randy's last mission. Randy's strand is one of the stranger chains outside the 100% checklist [1][3]. TechWiser reports some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress [4].
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Find Randy's strand and start his missions when they appear [1].
Play the chain through in order until the final mission unlocks [3].
Keep the chain moving as the story advances — windows are reported to follow story progress [4].
Complete Randy's final mission to pop the trophy [1].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason [1]. It is one of the stranger chains outside the 100% checklist [1][3]. TechWiser reports some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress [4].
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Play Tyrone's strand as Jason — the chain is Jason-only [1].
Play the chain through in order until the final mission unlocks [3].
Keep the chain moving as the story advances — windows are reported to follow story progress [4].
Complete Tyrone's final mission to pop the trophy [1].

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

dispute.a: PowerPyx flags the Chapter 1 balcony meditation as the one possibly missable spot, and says its author earned the trophy after doing it [1].
dispute.b: Other guides note it is still unconfirmed whether that balcony spot is actually required for the trophy, since the counter rises but the balcony is not marked as a spot [2][4]. Do it anyway — it costs minutes and removes the only known risk.

trophies.guide: Bronze for meditating at all 18 spots across Leonida — the only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable [1][3]. The first spot is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, offered after the mission Down to Earth: Lucia mentions meditating in the morning, heads to the balcony, and you follow and accept [1][3]. That spot is reported to vanish when Chapter 1 ends [1]. The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2 [1].
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: MISSABLE WINDOW — in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning [1][3].
When Lucia mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept the prompt [1].
Complete the balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1; it is reported gone after the chapter ends [1][3].
After Chapter 2, when both characters are playable together, the last spot opens up [1].
Visit the remaining 17 marked spots and meditate at each; the Progress menu counter tracks them [1][3].
Whether the balcony spot is strictly required is still unconfirmed — doing it removes the question [2][4].
Safety net: 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so a missed balcony cannot cost you A Long Road [1].

trophies.window: Chapter 1 only: after the mission Down to Earth, at Jason's house in the morning. Reported gone once Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bronze for hunting a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are Jason-only, and they are one of the few task lines the 100% checklist requires in full [1]. Study animals through binoculars as you travel — the checklist wants 100 of 255 studied, and hunting is separate from studying [1].
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Play Bret's strand as Jason — the chain is Jason-only [1].
Take Bret's hunting jobs in order until the unique-animal hunt appears [3].
Track the unique animal with the hunting tools the game gives you [1].
Take the animal down and complete the hunt for Bret [3].
Bret's quests are required in full for 100%, so finish the whole chain [1].

trophies.guide: Silver for completing 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game, and 100% completion asks for 15 of them, so this trophy is a small step on a much longer collection [3][8]. Cards are found across Leonida, including as mission and activity rewards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: There are 18 card sets in total; you need 3 full sets for this trophy [8].
Collect cards as you travel and finish the sets with the fewest cards missing first [3].
Check which sets are closest to complete and target their missing cards [1].
Keep collecting past 3 sets — 100% completion asks for 15 [3][8].
Log completed sets here; the third finished set pops the trophy [1].

trophies.guide: Silver for using the WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK is on Jason's and Lucia's phones (hold Up to open it) and scans landmarks, curiosities and sculptures [8]. Push Square breaks the scannables down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus tags [8]. The 100 scans are also a 100% checklist line [3].
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app on the phone (hold Up) whenever you reach a new place [8].
Scan landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) — every scan counts [8].
Scan as you travel during the story; backtracking later costs far more time [3].
WAiNK-scanning a vehicle also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good [1].
The trophy pops at 100 scanned locations, and 100% wants the same 100 [3].

trophies.guide: Bronze for completing 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and 100% completion asks for 70 of them, so you can skip the hardest ones [1]. Pick the 50 easiest first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: Open the challenge list — 80 challenges in eight groups of ten [1].
Clear the easiest groups first; driving, combat and exploration groups are usually quickest [3].
The trophy pops at 50, but keep going: 100% completion asks for 70 [1].
Skip any challenge that stalls you — the 10 hardest are optional for both goals [3].
Log your count here; the widget counts up to 50 [1].

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bronze for losing a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escaping. Do it with the other protagonist beside you — solo escapes do not count [1][3].
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Play with your partner beside you (the other protagonist) [1].
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars — police attention escalates with crimes committed [3].
Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear [1].
Escape the heat with your partner still with you to pop the trophy [3].

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. The chain breaks if the wanted level clears between robberies, so plan a tight route [1][3].
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Play with your partner beside you and pick three shops close together [1].
Rob the first shop and leave immediately for the second — do not wait around [3].
Keep your wanted level alive between robberies; losing it breaks the chain [1].
Rob the third shop while the wanted level is still active to pop the trophy [3].

trophies.guide: Bronze for discovering 100 vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it with WAiNK, and a scan alone is enough [8]. There are 277 base models; 100% completion asks for 200 of them [1].
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: Discover a vehicle by getting in it or scanning it with WAiNK [8].
Scan traffic near busy roads — new models pass constantly [1].
Vary the districts you drive through; models cluster by area [3].
The trophy pops at 100, but keep scanning: 100% wants 200 of 277 [1].
Log your count here; the widget counts up to 100 [8].

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Bronze for taking down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up before the fight: buff focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle [1][2]. A crowded firefight is the place to try it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Before the fight, buff focus with food, drinks or a shower at home [1].
Carry Adrenaline and an assault rifle into a fight with at least 5 enemies [2].
Trigger Combat Focus once the enemies are grouped and in range [1].
Take down 5 enemies before the focus meter runs out [2].
If it fails, reload a save and try a busier firefight [1].

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Bronze for making an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. This is a free-roam stunt at the airport, separate from the story mission VCIA Takedown [2][5].
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Go to VCIA airport in free-roam, outside the story mission [2].
Get hold of a plane on the airfield [1].
Take off without following the scheduled departure — leave the airport by air on your own terms [2].
The trophy pops on the unscheduled departure [5].

trophies.guide: Bronze with the cryptic description 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — the Rhinos are the game's tanks. The guides tie this trophy to dealing with Rhino tanks in the open world [2][5]. Treat the exact trigger as reported, not confirmed, and try the tank encounter in free-roam.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Raise enough heat in free-roam for Rhino tanks to be sent against you [2].
Engage the Rhinos rather than running from them [1].
Deal with the tanks — destroying or surviving them is what the guides report as the trigger [2].
The trophy pops when the Rhino encounter resolves as the guides describe [5].

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole requirement — being spotted voids the attempt, so plan the entry and the exit before you start [1][3].
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and scout it first: cameras, staff and sightlines [1].
Enter quietly and keep out of every sightline while you take the goods [3].
Leave without raising an alarm — detection voids the attempt [1].
If spotted, leave and retry; the trophy only counts a clean run [3].

trophies.guide: Silver for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping. Bank vault robberies are also a 100% checklist line — KeenGamer counts 8 vault robberies in the checklist — so these five are progress toward both goals [3].
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Bank vault robberies appear as jobs across Leonida — take them when offered [3].
Rob the vault, then escape cleanly; the escape is part of the requirement [1].
Repeat for 5 vaults — the checklist wants 8, so keep going past the trophy [3].
Bring a fast getaway vehicle and a planned route before each job [1].
Log vaults here; the fifth escape pops the trophy [3].

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing an armored truck and escaping. Armored trucks travel Leonida's roads; hit one, take the goods and get away clean [1][3].
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road in free-roam [1].
Stop the truck and take its goods [3].
Escape the police response and lose the wanted level [1].
The trophy pops once you have escaped with the haul [3].

trophies.guide: Bronze for exploring all of Leonida — clearing the fog from the whole map across its 52 areas [2][5]. Drive, fly and sail into every corner; the map fills in as you go.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Open the map and note the fogged areas — 52 areas in total [2].
Travel into each fogged area; the map clears as you enter it [1].
Use roads, water and air to reach islands and remote corners [5].
The trophy pops when the last area is revealed [2].
Exploring also feeds vehicle discovery and WAiNK scans, so combine the trips [1].

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs [2][5]. Gang operations are also a 100% checklist line — 39 of them — so this trophy is an early milestone on a longer grind [3].
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: Illegal operations belong to 9 gangs; you need one from each [2].
Take gang-operation jobs as they appear across Leonida [3].
Track which gangs you have hit and target the missing ones [1].
The trophy pops on the ninth gang's operation [3].
Keep going past it — 100% wants 39 gang operations in total [3].

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Bronze for enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions the guides list as unknown — PowerPyx does not confirm a method [1][2]. The description itself is the best clue: go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or vendor with a view, and order a cocktail.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown, so treat every step as a report, not a fact [1].
Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City in free-roam [2].
Find a bar or vendor on the beachfront with a view of the ocean [4].
Order and enjoy a cocktail there — the description points at the drink plus the view [2].
If it does not pop, check the community guides again: early lists may refine the trigger [1].

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Bronze for smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions the guides list as unknown [1][2]. The description points at the act itself: take a vehicle and smash out through the showroom front.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown [1].
Find a vehicle showroom in free-roam and go inside [2].
Get into a vehicle on the showroom floor [4].
Drive out through the showroom front — smashing the glass, in classic style [2].
If it does not pop, the trigger may need a specific showroom; check updated guides [1].

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bronze for a follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Bowling is an activity in Leonida; play a game at that alley and follow through on your throws [1][3].
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley [1].
Start a game of bowling there [3].
Bowl with a full follow-through on your throws [1].
Finish the game; the trophy pops on the follow-through [3].
Bowling also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None [1].

trophies.guide: Bronze with the cryptic description 'A partnership with mass appeal'. The guides do not yet confirm the exact trigger, so treat this as unconfirmed [1][2][4]. The wording points at doing something as a partnership — with your partner beside you — in front of a crowd or on camera, so try partner activities that draw attention.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — no guide yet confirms the exact trigger for this trophy [1].
The description points at a partnership with mass appeal: try partner activities in public, crowded places [2].
Play with your partner beside you and do something showy — a stunt, a race win or a public moment [4].
If it does not pop, check updated community guides before spending more time on it [2].
Do not confuse it with Hot Together, which is specifically about losing a 4-star wanted level together [1].

trophies.guide: Bronze for choices made, for better or worse — PSN tracks a count up to 500 for this trophy [2][5]. Choices appear across the game: dialogue picks, mission decisions and open-world calls. Make them as you play and the count climbs; the exact list of counted choices is still being mapped by the community [1][4].
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: PSN tracks choices toward this trophy, up to a count of 500 [2].
Make choices whenever the game offers them — dialogue, missions and open-world decisions [5].
Keep playing normally; the count climbs across story and side content [1].
The exact list of counted choices is still being mapped — check updated guides if the count stalls [4].
Log progress here; the widget counts up to 500 [1].

trophies.guide: Bronze with the cryptic description 'Second time's the charm'. This is one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions the guides list as unknown [1][2]. The wording points at succeeding on a second attempt at something — retry an activity or challenge you failed once and complete it on the second try.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown [1].
The description points at a second attempt: fail an activity, then complete it on the retry [2].
Try it on a repeatable activity — a race, a challenge or an arcade game [4].
Fail once, then succeed on the immediate second attempt [2].
If it does not pop, the trigger may be tied to a specific activity; check updated guides [1].

dispute.a: PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown [1].
dispute.b: Early player reports link it to a strange sky or world event in free-roam, but no guide has confirmed the trigger [2][4]. Until two sources agree, treat the event theory as unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Bronze with the cryptic description 'What the hell just happened?' — one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions the guides list as unknown [1][2]. Early player reports link it to a strange event in the open world, but that is unconfirmed, so the honest guide is: keep playing free-roam, watch for unusual events, and check updated guides.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown [1].
Early player reports link it to a strange sky or world event in free-roam [2].
Explore unusual places and watch the sky while travelling at night [4].
If an odd event plays out around you, stay with it until it ends [2].
Check updated community guides before grinding for it — the trigger is not yet confirmed [1].

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bronze for bowling someone over with a melee drive-by — striking a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. This is one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions the guides list as unknown [1][2]. The description itself names the act: a melee attack from a drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown [1].
The description names the act: a melee drive-by that bowls someone over [2].
Drive slowly past a pedestrian with a melee weapon ready [4].
Strike with the melee attack from the moving vehicle [2].
If it does not pop, the target or speed may matter; check updated guides [1].

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze for earning $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; launder them through contacts rather than spending them dirty [1][3]. Bank jobs and gang operations are the steadiest source of marked bills.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Collect marked bills from robberies — bank jobs and gang operations pay them [1].
Launder the bills through your contacts, not by spending them directly [3].
Each laundered batch counts toward the $250,000 total [1].
Keep robbing and laundering until the total hits $250,000 [3].
Log the total here; the widget counts up to $250,000 [1].

trophies.guide: Bronze for spending $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles and property upgrades all add up [1][3]. Spend naturally through the story and the 100% grind, and top up at the end if needed.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Buy what the game asks for first — weapons, ammo, clothes and vehicle upgrades [1].
Every shop purchase counts toward the $100,000, across all shop types [3].
Check your spent total in the Progress menu as you go [1].
Near the end, top up with big purchases if you are short [3].
Log the total here; the widget counts up to $100,000 [1].

trophies.guide: Bronze for purchasing all 8 garage properties [2][5]. Garages are bought across Leonida; they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida [2].
Find each garage on the map and buy it when you can afford it [5].
Save money for them during the story — property is the biggest single expense [1].
The trophy pops when the eighth garage is purchased [2].
Garages also store vehicles you discover for Whip It Good [1].

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Bronze for registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles you own or discover — the app takes the registration, and ten of them pops the trophy [1][3].
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app on the phone [1].
Register a vehicle you own or have discovered [3].
Repeat for 10 different vehicles [1].
Use vehicles you already drive daily — no special cars are needed [3].
The tenth registration pops the trophy [1].
